parameters.description: set to "body" for non-browser clients (refresh token in the response body instead of a cookie)

post.summary: Revoke the current refresh session (immediate, never tolerated inside the reuse interval)

parameters.name: X-Refresh-Token
parameters.description: refresh token for non-browser clients (cookie alternative)

get.summary: Return the authenticated user, role and permissions

patch.description: Rotates the bcrypt hash, bumps the token version (all access tokens become invalid) and revokes every refresh session.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh cookie and issue a new access token
post.description: The presented refresh token is revoked and replaced. Token rotation is slid: an actively used session never has to sign in again, up to auth.refresh_max_lifetime. A token replayed within auth.refresh_reuse_interval is tolerated (multi-tab race); outside that window it revokes every session. Browsers use the HttpOnly cookie; non-browser clients may send X-Refresh-Token and receive the rotated token in the body.

parameters.name: X-Refresh-Token
parameters.description: refresh token for non-browser clients (cookie alternative)
